keyframes_css: @keyframes fold-1 { 0% { transform: rotateY(0deg); } 50% { transform: rotateY(180deg); } 100% { transform: rotateY(0deg); } } @keyframes fold-2 { 0% { transform: rotateX(0deg); } 50% { transform: rotateX(180deg); } 100% { transform: rotateX(0deg); } } @keyframes fold-3 { 0% { transform: rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(360deg); } 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); } } .demo-stage { width: 200px; height: 200px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd89b 0%, #fff5e1 100%); border-radius: 10px; perspective: 1000px; } .demo-stage .paper { width: 100px; height: 100px; background: linear-gradient(45deg, #ff6b6b, #ff8e8e); position: absolute; } .demo-stage .paper-1 { animation: fold-1 3s ease-in-out infinite; } .demo-stage .paper-2 { animation: fold-2 3s ease-in-out infinite; animation-delay: 0.3s; opacity: 0.8; background: linear-gradient(45deg, #4ecdc4, #6ee7de); } .demo-stage .paper-3 { animation: fold-3 3s ease-in-out infinite; animation-delay: 0.6s; opacity: 0.6; background: linear-gradient(45deg, #ffa502, #ffb84d); } .demo-stage .paper::before, .demo-stage .paper::after { content: ''; position: absolute; background: inherit; } .demo-stage .paper::before { width: 50%; height: 100%; opacity: 0.7; } .demo-stage .paper::after { width: 100%; height: 50%; opacity: 0.5; }
